justification: `src/main/java11/org/jsoup/helper/HttpClientExecutor.java` is a 187-line class with multiple responsibilities: it caches/reuses `HttpClient` instances (`client()`), builds request bodies (`requestBody()`), manages per-request proxy state via a thread-local and nested `ProxyWrap`, translates `HttpResponse` into jsoup `Response` objects in `execute()`, formats status messages, and handles cleanup (`safeClose()`). `src/test/java11/org/jsoup/helper/HttpClientExecutorTest.java` also exercises `ProxyWrap` separately from request execution, showing the proxy logic is a distinct concern embedded in the same class. This breadth indicates the class is not fully decomposed.
